verdict.rationale: kitty is configured through a documented plain-text kitty.conf file. A hands-on community user confirms the config 'fits in a dotfiles repo', and another user's wish for a GUI config method shows the configuration is text-based. Missing for 10: substantive first-party doc content (the pack has only page titles) on config file location, include/modular files and per-machine overrides, plus explicit evidence of syncing the config across multiple machines.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can keep the terminal's full configuration as plain-text files in my dotfiles and sync it across machines

citations.quote: the docs are clear and it fits in a dotfiles repo
